title: WeSearch: A Unified Model-Centric Retrieval Framework for WeChat Search
abstract: arXiv:2611.00530v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present WeSearch, a unified, model-centric retrieval framework for large-scale, continuously evolving content search. Prevailing methods assign documents fixed hierarchical Semantic IDs, implicitly assuming each document follows a single coherent semantic path-an assumption that often breaks down for multi-topic documents. WeSearch instead retrieves query-relevant clusters and then ranks atomic documents within the resulting query-specific candidate space, decoupling candidate pruning from fine-grained relevance modeling. Combined with relevance-aware training, compact document representations, and incremental index updates, this design enables weekly-or daily when needed-model refreshes. Deployed as the primary semantic retrieval path in WeChat Search alongside a lexical syntax tree, WeSearch shows consistent one-week A/B gains on corpora from hundreds of millions to billions of documents, and a one-month full-traffic A/B test conf

translated_title: WeSearch：面向微信搜索的统一以模型为中心的检索框架
translated_abstract: 我们提出了WeSearch，一个面向大规模、持续演进内容搜索的统一以模型为中心的检索框架。现有主流方法为文档分配固定的层次化语义ID，隐含地假设每篇文档遵循单一连贯的语义路径——这一假设对于多主题文档往往不成立。WeSearch则改为检索与查询相关的簇，然后在由此产生的查询特定候选空间内对原子文档进行排序，从而将候选剪枝与细粒度相关性建模解耦。结合相关性感知训练、紧凑的文档表示和增量索引更新，这一设计使模型能够每周刷新（必要时可每天刷新）。WeSearch已作为微信搜索的主要语义检索路径与词汇语法树并行部署，在从数亿到数十亿文档规模的语料库上展现出持续的为期一周的A/B测试收益，为期一个月的全流量A/B测试也证实了……
tldr: WeSearch提出了一种以模型为中心的统一检索框架，通过先检索查询相关簇、再在查询特定候选空间中对原子文档排序，将候选剪枝与细粒度相关性建模解耦，并已作为微信搜索的主要语义检索路径部署，在大规模语料上取得了持续的A/B测试收益。
en_tdlr: WeSearch is a unified model-centric retrieval framework that decouples candidate pruning from fine-grained relevance modeling by first retrieving query-relevant clusters and then ranking atomic documents within query-specific candidate spaces, and it has been deployed as the primary semantic retrieval path in WeChat Search with consistent A/B gains at billion-scale.
